# Avatar framing fixture

`astronaut.png` is NASA's portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins, distributed by
scikit-image 0.24.0 as a public-domain image.

Source: https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.24.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png
Provenance: https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.24.0/skimage/data/_fetchers.py (`astronaut`)

Used only to test face location and adjustable framing, never identity inference.
